type.description: The type of the middleware action, specifically 'validation'.

endpoint.description: The endpoint URL for the middleware.

actions.description: Either an array of actions or a JSON-encoded string representing an array of actions.

config.description: Either a configuration object or a JSON-encoded string representing a configuration object.

active.description: Can be a string ('1' or '0') or a boolean (true or false) representing the active state.

headers.description: Either a headers object or a JSON-encoded string representing a headers object.

projectId.description: The project ID, which can be an integer or a string.
